title: Windows NPS or FreeRADIUS: Choosing a RADIUS Server for Wi-Fi and VPN Authentication
excerpt: Network Policy Server ships with Windows Server; FreeRADIUS is the open-source standard on Linux. The comparison covers cost, Active Directory integration, flexibility and the skills each one expects from your team.
verdict: Use NPS if your environment is Windows and Active Directory end to end: it is the quickest way to get 802.1X and VPN authentication working. Choose FreeRADIUS if your team is comfortable on Linux and needs more control, complex policies or scripting, at no licence cost.

spec1.label: Cost
spec1.device1Value: Included with your Windows Server licence

spec2.label: Active Directory integration
spec2.device1Value: Native, since it is part of the same ecosystem

spec3.label: Flexibility and customisation
spec3.device1Value: Limited to what the Windows console exposes
spec3.device2Value: Very high, with modules and scripting

spec4.label: Learning curve
spec4.device2Value: Steeper; expects Linux skills and text-based configuration
